Projects

Over the course of my undergraduate I've made an effort to take part in several extra-curricular projects to develop my skills, particularly in ecological analysis, programming, and technical writing.

Ecosystem Modelling Suitability Assessment (Special Research Course) - 2025

An extra-curricular Summer research project where I was tasked with investigating the suitability of the R package 'Rpath' for examining climate change scenarios. Rpath is designed to compliment the Ecological toolbox Ecopath with Ecosim that helps answer questions about energy flows in ecosystems using biomass.

COMING SOON - Machine Learning Dataset Report Generator (Volunteering) - 2024

A volunteer Summer research project on pre-processing, designing, analysing and generating reports on machine learning animal behaviour classification datasets. The project artefact was an end-to-end R program that takes raw datasets, completes pre-processing, classification and then produces an easy to read report for consultants working with animal accelerometry datasets.

COMING SOON - Acoustic Bat Data Research Project (Volunteering) - 2024

A volunteer Summer research project on factors influencing acoustic presence by Australian bat species. The purpose of the project was to review literature on environmental variables that influenced the detection of bat species by acoustic recorders. As part of the project I wrote a script that steps the user through automatically cleaning up Kaleidoscope acoustic data.
